sec: sec:C006: Prevent output vulnerabilities / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C006: Prevent output vulnerabilities / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Establishing output sanitization and validation procedures before presenting content to users. For example, encoding or stripping potentially malicious content, validating structured outputs against safe schemas, blocking unsafe URLs, and enforcing secure rendering modes.

sentences.text: Establishing output sanitization and validation procedures before presenting content to users.
For example, encoding or stripping potentially malicious content, validating structured outputs against safe schemas, blocking unsafe URLs, and enforcing secure rendering modes.

blocks.id: blk:C006: Prevent output vulnerabilities / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing content handling and security labelling based on trust level. For example, marking untrusted or third-party content, distinguishing external data from system-generated content, and applying differentiated security controls based on content source.
